label: Mere conservation: residual transfer holds and a cause of being fails to cause a perfection
paraphrase: Closed control on one three-member interpretation with two respects, esse and one further perfection, all members in act in both (the top causes the esse of the other two; only the maker causes the further perfection, and only in the made thing): the mere-conservation rival holds; the residual transfer condition for non-universal causes and self-effects holds (vacuously: the top is the only cause of esse and causes none in itself); and it is false that whatever causes a thing's esse causes each of its actual perfections. A statement about this interpretation only.
